_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 06: 2024-11-04 to 2024-11-20. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He saw four oak trees and thought it meant four years, but cautions against assuming or speculating about what the Spirit shows, saying the full interpretation can take months or years to come.
mentions.quote: I saw four oak trees and I thought it meant four years
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as stated: he withdraws his own reading in the same breath as giving it.

mentions.claim_text: Asked whether the crash he saw can be averted he says he has no idea, only that he now sees a covering and that things are different when he prays over it than at any point earlier in the year, and that the 2024 warnings got pushed back.
mentions.quote: you saw a crash I did can some of that be averted
mentions.condition_text: he attributes the change to prayer and to America blessing Israel
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as framed: the crash is kept and its date removed in the same sentence.

mentions.claim_text: Announcement of a February conference with Billy Brim and Rick Renner teaching end times eschatology.
mentions.quote: the conference with Billy Brim. It's coming in in February
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event announcement.

mentions.claim_text: He commends the conference teachers for giving straight word of God on the end times rather than flakiness, and notes there is all of November, December and January to pray about attending.
mentions.quote: Not flakiness, just straight up word of God
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event promotion.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that angels lead police and agents to check the right car or place without knowing why, so that calamity or plots forming against the people do not prosper.
mentions.quote: your angels would lead them. and they may not even know it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a prevented plot leaves no trace to check.

mentions.claim_text: He reports emails from viewers who conceived around the same time frame, possibly the same day they prayed, and reads it as God growing families in the kingdom.
mentions.quote: they conceived all in the same time frame
mentions.falsify_match: Self-reported viewer outcomes, not independently checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is going to use the channel in a very unusual way, with demonstrations and manifestations of glory for salvation, deliverance and healing.
mentions.quote: to use this channel in an unusual way a very unusual way
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion for unusual use of a channel.

mentions.claim_text: He recommends a minister whose service changed his life, and mentions Billy Brim's February conference at Glorious Church Fellowship.
mentions.quote: he prayed for me my life will never be the same
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: recommendation.

mentions.claim_text: Further detail on the February conference at Glorious Church Fellowship, running roughly Sunday to Wednesday.
mentions.quote: it's going to be in February and um they're coming to the Glorious Church
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event logistics.

mentions.claim_text: He puts the conference in the first week of February and encourages viewers to support it, with his wife adding that they love eschatology and end times teaching.
mentions.quote: I believe it's first first week of February
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event logistics.

mentions.claim_text: Encouragement that a due season is coming for those in hard marriages, hard situations with children or other trouble, and that they must keep fighting the good fight of faith.
mentions.quote: in due season's coming in season's coming
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an undated promise with a perseverance clause.

mentions.claim_text: He says Isaacs are coming, not only babies but blessings, increase, new jobs, multiplication and promotions in every area of life.
mentions.quote: there's Isaac's coming not just in babies but in in every area of your life
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal provision with no external criterion.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that the steps of the righteous are ordered by the Lord, who knows the size of any mistake, so nothing is too much to overcome.
mentions.quote: the steps of the righteous order of the Lord
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He says the best is yet to come and there is no doom and gloom for the body of Christ regardless, though there will seem to be doom and gloom in the world.
mentions.quote: there's no Doom and Gloom for the body of Christ regardless we win
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and structurally so: the church wins whatever happens in the world.

mentions.claim_text: He says he just saw something concerning the Thanksgiving Day Parade and prays a hedge of protection over those attending so there is no terrorist attack on it.
mentions.quote: I just saw that concerning the Thanksgiving Day Parade
mentions.condition_text: given as a prayer target the moment he sees it
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade on 28 November 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He describes sowing a sacrificial thanksgiving offering, an amount that differs each time, believing for a financial blessing over all of 2025.
mentions.quote: we sew into 2025 believing for a financial blessing all over 2025
mentions.condition_text: the blessing is tied to the sacrificial seed
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private financial outcome tied to giving.

mentions.claim_text: Offering prayer for harvest and covering over 2025, declaring it an amazing year, exceedingly abundantly above all they dare ask or think.
mentions.quote: 2025 will be an amazing year yes exceedingly abundantly above all
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no external criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He calls the seed his stamp in the spirit realm for a blessed 2025, with supernatural favour so that everywhere he sets his foot prospers and they will not struggle.
mentions.quote: it's like my my stamp in the spirit realm
mentions.condition_text: the outcome is anchored to the seed sown
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private outcome.

mentions.claim_text: He urges believing God for big, saying they did it for 2024 and are seeing fruit of things that were impossible in the natural.
mentions.quote: for 2024 and there's things that I know that in the natural were impossible
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: unspecified personal fruit.

mentions.claim_text: A word of knowledge for someone with swollen feet and ankles, possibly not pregnancy, with gout and all swelling commanded to go.
mentions.quote: I just saw swollen feet
mentions.falsify_match: Words of knowledge of this kind describe conditions common enough in any large audience to be expected by chance.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for the glory cloud to rest on viewers with healings and demonstrations never seen before, including arms, legs, eyes and ears restored.
mentions.quote: people having arms and legs and eyes and ears
mentions.falsify_match: Documented restoration of missing limbs would be decisive; none is claimed here, only prayed for.

mentions.claim_text: Announcement that Billy Burke is coming to Tulsa on 8 and 9 December, a meeting he believes has the opportunity for the glory to show up.
mentions.quote: Billy Burke is coming to Tulsa Oklahoma uh December the 8th and the 9th
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event announcement.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the two conference teachers have never taught end times material together before and are doing a week-long meeting in February.
mentions.quote: they've never done a meeting together teaching on end time stuff together ever
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event promotion.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching to refuse other people's negativity and bad medical reports, including being told you have two weeks to live, and to hold bulldog faith on the word instead.
mentions.quote: you got two weeks to live buddy but you got to have that Bulldog Faith
mentions.condition_text: outcome tied to refusing the report
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching, and one that makes a bad outcome a failure of faith.

mentions.claim_text: Healing prayer over women's bodies and men's prostates and testosterone levels, with him saying he sees the fire of the Holy Spirit moving on viewers as he prays.
mentions.quote: I believe the fire is coming on you right now I see it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching from David that God's thoughts toward each person are constant, as we think of those we love throughout the day and even at night.
mentions.quote: God told David about his thoughts towards us
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer not to be the same a year from now but to go from glory to glory rather than camping in satisfaction.
mentions.quote: I don't want to be this same today this time next year
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal spiritual growth.

mentions.claim_text: He states a goal of raising a million-person prayer army on YouTube praying daily for the nations by 2025, taking communion and praying over what the Lord gives them.
mentions.quote: million prayer Army on this YouTube platform bringing forth a million people
mentions.falsify_match: A million people praying daily with the channel, checkable against subscriber and view counts.
mentions.falsify_miss: The audience stays well below a million daily participants.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that there be no virus or plague at all through 2025, 2026, 2027 and 2028, and declares there is no longer a plan to take down the dollar because it has been averted.
mentions.quote: a major virus again in 2024 going into I mean I 2025 2026 2027
mentions.falsify_match: No major virus and no dollar collapse through 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: Either arrives, which would sit against this declaration and with his own plague claims.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord asking what will be done with the extra time granted over the next four years into the 2028 cycle, and what kind of revival there will be if they get lazy in the blessing.
mentions.quote: I'm giving more more time time to do what I'm giving
mentions.condition_text: the outcome of the window depends on what is done with it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a granted window whose success depends on the hearers' response.

mentions.claim_text: He names the years he is seeing as a sequence: 2020, then 2025, 2026, 2027 and 2028.
mentions.quote: years I see it it goes 2020 2025 2026 2027 and 2028
mentions.falsify_match: The named years carry the events he attaches to them elsewhere.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that healing is settled as a foundation, and that being moved by the flesh means being moved by circumstances rather than standing on the word.
mentions.quote: healed. And that's foundation. And that settles it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He says Chicago alone kept Illinois from going red, that he saw red spread over all America as a red wave, and that he told viewers a year earlier in November what the Lord would do in 2024.
mentions.quote: I saw it all that red come over America and I saw the Red Wave
mentions.falsify_match: A Republican sweep in November 2024, checkable against the result and against the date he claims to have given it.
mentions.falsify_miss: No sweep, or no record of the earlier telling.

mentions.claim_text: Asked what happens to the economy now, he says he saw a great house of cards coming down, does not know the timing, and prays it is not in 2025.
mentions.quote: I saw a great house of cards coming down when the timing of that is
mentions.condition_text: he prays the timing away from 2025
mentions.falsify_match: A systemic financial collapse in the US.
mentions.falsify_miss: No collapse, though he supplies no date to fail against.

mentions.claim_text: He restates the four-year window ending with the shmita cycle in 2028 and tells viewers outside the United States it applies to them too, because it is about the shmita cycle rather than about America.
mentions.quote: we have a four-year window and the shimita cycle ends in 2028
mentions.falsify_match: The window runs to the close of the shmita cycle in 2028.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him much prayer went up over the month of October and that he is granting more grace over what would have been hell on earth, describing it as a small window, and he says he has no idea whether that means only until the first of the year.
mentions.quote: there was like a a a small little window a small little window
mentions.condition_text: the grace is attributed to October intercession
mentions.time_phrase: a small window, maybe until the first of the year
mentions.falsify_match: The reprieve proves short, ending around the start of 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: It runs four years, as the December tellings have it.

mentions.claim_text: He says that back in May he saw the New York Yankees and the Los Angeles Dodgers going to the World Series, and also saw attempted attacks on Yankee Stadium, with the Lord repeatedly telling him to watch and pray for the Yankees.
mentions.quote: I saw the vision of the New York Yankees going to the World Series
mentions.condition_text: the attacks were given as a prayer assignment
mentions.time_phrase: back in May, then the World Series
mentions.falsify_match: Yankees and Dodgers did meet in the 2024 World Series, which is checkable; the attack half is not, since none occurred.
mentions.falsify_miss: The matchup half fails only if the teams differed.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that the Lord had him watching the Yankees since May so that they would pray against attacks at the World Series, saying he knew they were going but had no idea whether they would win, and that he then saw Los Angeles.
mentions.quote: the World Series I just had no idea if they were going to win
mentions.falsify_match: The matchup is verifiable; he explicitly disclaims knowing the winner, which narrows the claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord tells him well in advance who will win the Super Bowl, that he writes it down and keeps it private between himself, his wife and his children, and that he has learned to build on that.
mentions.quote: he'll tell me way in advance who's going to win the Super Bowl
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable by design: a testable claim deliberately withheld from the record.

mentions.claim_text: Turning back to the economy, he takes up the objection that he said the economy would crash and said things about interest rates, and says he prefers to be real rather than hyper.
mentions.quote: you said the economy is going to crash you said that
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: him restating the objection before answering it.
